purpose: Ordinary package tests must respect the Project.toml Julia caret compatibility; source qualification remains locked to Julia 1.12.6 and 1.13.1.
production_implementation_changes: None to StrictJuliaSyntax or the frozen test/oracle. Only package registration and supplemental execution wiring may change.
package_contract: Always run 21 portable independent cases on any package-compatible Julia runtime. Additionally run the original frozen test unmodified on both exact qualified versions. No version-incompatible frozen oracle is silently reinterpreted.

portable_expected_cases.T01: A Symbol named error and a LineNumberNode are not parser error Expr nodes.
portable_expected_cases.T02: A valid call nested in 64 block Expr nodes is not an error.
portable_expected_cases.T03: A direct Expr(:error, message) is an error.
portable_expected_cases.T04: A direct Expr(:incomplete, message) is an error.
portable_expected_cases.T05: A nested error after a valid toplevel assignment is an error.
portable_expected_cases.T06: A nested incomplete node after a valid toplevel assignment is an error.
portable_expected_cases.P01: Empty text and its file are valid.
portable_expected_cases.P02: Line and block comments are valid.
portable_expected_cases.P03: A Unicode module and identifiers are valid.
portable_expected_cases.P04: An explicit Float64 zero comparison followed by spaced short circuit return is valid.
portable_expected_cases.P05: An explicit Float64 zero comparison followed by spaced short circuit break is valid.
portable_expected_cases.P06: A syntactically valid file-writing specimen parses without creating its marker.
portable_expected_cases.N01: An unmatched closing parenthesis is rejected.
portable_expected_cases.N02: An unfinished function declaration is rejected.
portable_expected_cases.N04: An otherwise valid prefix followed by malformed syntax is rejected.
portable_expected_cases.C01: main on several valid files returns Int zero.
portable_expected_cases.C02: main on valid and malformed files returns Int one.
portable_expected_cases.C03: main on no paths returns Int one.
portable_expected_cases.C04: check_file rejects a missing path and main returns Int one for it.
portable_expected_cases.C05: Meta.parseall may return an error-bearing Expr for unmatched-parenthesis text; the strict checker rejects it. Parsing never evaluates candidate text.

validation: Run this unconditional portable registration as an additional Base-only supplemental workflow step under both exact versions, in a separate Julia process from the unchanged frozen-oracle step. Keep original full18/native3/jobs/tests/experiments/tolerances/clocks. Recheck all source and Git bindings before a single existing-ref push.
world_age_and_namespaces: Portable helper is loaded into the registration's own module at top level. The frozen test continues to load its helper into Main; these must not collide.
